name: M4_future_grouped_probe_draft_v1
base_population: 162069 frozen qualified Base26 source Train IDs; no N residual eligibility restriction

inner_dev: only preregistered design selection if separately specified; no fitting of transforms
data_ownership.full_Train_historical_M0_or_normalizatio: Never reuse for independent-fold claims; no changes to historical assets

condition_window: past 150 physical samples; no future frames or absolute log position

reference.sample_eligibility: inner_fit qualified_y0 AND whole_window_label_valid AND fault_fraction0
reference.weights: association group equal, within-group eligible normal case equal, within-case normal windows equal; U/C/CF identical
reference.latent: fold-specific frozen MSTCA h128, not generated now
reference.kernel: Gaussian standardized squared distance divided by dimension; log-sum-exp evaluation
reference.common_score_scale: inner_fit normal leave-association-group U score weighted median/IQR; common to U/C; not independent encoder validation
reference.training_query: exclude whole query association_group from normal reference for inner-fit head updates; inner-dev/outer use all inner-fit reference; save this query-population difference
reference.unsupported_reference: same support mask across U/C/CF; correction0, base-head fallback and explicit no-reference flag; ID stays in main denominator
reference.continuous_support_rule: UNRESOLVED before formal authorization; proposed group/case ESS plus training-only context-distance audit; count support cannot certify effective local support

arms.M4-CF: m_theta(h)+max(r_C,0)+(1-sigmoid(m_A))*min(r_C,0); same C reference, frozen common M0 anchor

CF_loss_proposal: Focal + lambda*mean(max(0,m_A-m_CF)^2 on training y1 and anchor m_A>0); lambda1 proposed, no guarantee
CF_ablation_scope: joint gate-plus-protection loss only; cannot attribute to components separately

training_proposal.common_anchor: fresh M0 trained within inner_fit only, selected on inner_dev
training_proposal.update: existing Linear128x2 head only,258 trainable parameters in every arm
training_proposal.pretraining_opportunity: identical copied anchor for all four arms; all four receive new identical optimization opportunity
training_proposal.normal_dictionary_capacity: additional nonparametric storage/complexity; U/C same centers; not claimed to have exactly equal statistical capacity
training_proposal.capacity_rule: if future trainable module added, new capacity-matched design and authorization required
training_proposal.sampler: single uniform-replacement arm; common sampled IDs; draws per epoch = inner_fit population
training_proposal.selection: inner-dev overall Macro-F1 strict maximum; earliest exact tie
training_proposal.working_point: fault probability>0.5; exact tie normal; no outer threshold sweep
training_proposal.budget_estimate_not_authorization: per fold1 anchor+4 head jobs; 3 folds15 jobs; no automatic launch, extra arm or seed

acceptance_proposal.relative_recall: integer TP_M4>=TP_M0-matched for overall, six fault types, SIL overall, HIL overall, each fold and pooled OOF
acceptance_proposal.fault_by_domain: all12 cells reported; whether additional hard gates is unresolved owner decision
acceptance_proposal.absolute_R_star: overall,six faults,SIL,HIL all unset; application risk/mission basis required; exploratory results only until specified
acceptance_proposal.FPR: after recall/coverage gates, all-normal and independent-normal FP strictly lower; predeclared Hover/low-motion and worst-case measures nonworse; report all directories/states
acceptance_proposal.coverage: all original Base26 qualified IDs remain; separate input,reference,fallback and final decision coverage; no unknown-as-normal or denominator shrinking
acceptance_proposal.uncertainty: case/group units, keep SIL/HIL pairs; one seed not significance; later only one retained candidate vs baseline paired seeds if separately approved
acceptance_proposal.continuous_replay: only after window gates and separate authorization; event recall, false events/hour, threshold/confirmation/actual emission,flushes,unavailable time,latency and20ms backlog; no existing M3/M4 trained-best claim

unresolved_admission: owner accepts narrowed claims despite sparse state-fault-domain cells
continuous-condition support and score calibration gate frozen
conditional fault absorption not yet tested
absolute R* or explicit exploration-only scope
mathematical proposal and frozen-encoder fairness reviewed
